an4.243:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā kosambiyaṃ viharati ghositārāme.
an4.243:1.2: atha kho āyasmā ānando yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ bhagavā etadavoca:
an4.243:1.3: api nu taṃ ānanda adhikaraṇaṃ vupasantanti?
an4.243:1.5: āyasmato bhante anuruddhassa bāhiyo nāma saddhivihāriko kevalakappaṃ saṅghabhedāya ṭhito.
an4.243:1.6: tatthāyasmā anuruddho na ekavācikampi bhaṇitabbaṃ maññatī” ti.
an4.243:2.1: kadā panānanda anuruddho saṅghamajjhe adhikaraṇesu voyuñjati?
an4.243:2.2: nanu ānanda yāni kāni ci adhikaraṇāni uppajjanti sabbāni tāni tumhe ceva vūpasametha sāriputtamoggallānā ca.
an4.243:3.1: cattārome ānanda atthavase sampassamāno pāpabhikkhu saṅghabhedena nandati.
an4.243:3.3: idhānanda pāpabhikkhu dussīlo hoti pāpadhammo asuci saṅkassarasamācāro paṭicchannakammanto assamaṇo samaṇapaṭiñño abrahmacārī brahmacārīpaṭiñño antopūti avassuto kasambujāto.
an4.243:3.6: ‘dussīlo pāpadhammo asuci saṃkassarasamācāro paṭicchannakammanto assamaṇo samaṇapaṭiñño abrahmacārī brahmacārīpaṭiñño antopūti avassuto kasambujāto’ti. samaggā maṃ santā nāsissanti.
an4.243:3.8: idaṃ ānanda paṭhamaṃ atthavasaṃ sampassamāno pāpabhikkhu saṅghabhedena nandati.
an4.243:4.1: puna caparaṃ ānanda pāpabhikkhu micchādiṭṭhiko hoti antaggāhikāya diṭṭhiyā samannāgato.
an4.243:4.4: ‘micchādiṭṭhiko antaggāhikāya diṭṭhiyā samannāgato’ti. samaggā maṃ santā nāsissanti.
an4.243:4.6: idaṃ ānanda dutiyaṃ atthavasaṃ sampassamāno pāpabhikkhu saṅghabhedena nandati.
an4.243:5.1: puna caparaṃ ānanda pāpabhikkhu micchāājīvo hoti. micchājīvena jīvikaṃ kappeti.
an4.243:5.4: ‘micchāājīvo micchāājīvena jīvikaṃ kappetī’ti. samaggā pana maṃ nāsissanti.
an4.243:5.6: idaṃ ānanda tatiyaṃ atthavasaṃ sampassamāno pāpabhikkhu saṅghabhedena nandati.
an4.243:6.1: puna caparaṃ ānanda pāpabhikkhu lābhakāmo hoti sakkārakāmo anavaññattikāmo.
an4.243:6.4: ‘lābhakāmo sakkārakāmo anavaññattikāmo’ti, samaggā maṃ na sakkarissanti na garukarissanti na mānessanti na pūjessanti.
an4.243:6.5: vaggā pana maṃ sakkarissanti garukarissanti mānessanti pūjessantī”ti.
an4.243:6.6: idaṃ ānanda catutthaṃ atthavasaṃ sampassamāno pāpabhikkhu saṅghabhedena nandati.
an4.243:6.7: ime kho ānanda cattāro atthavase sampassamāno pāpabhikkhu saṅghabhedena nandatīti.
